newsitem.title: USA: Wyser-Pratte says withdraws request for meeting.
newsitem.headline: Wyser-Pratte says withdraws request for meeting.

text.p: Shareholder group Wyser-Pratte & Co Inc, along with Providence Capital Inc, said Tuesday it would withdraw its request to hold a special shareholders meeting in light of a Comsat Corp announcement on Monday that it would hold an annual meeting on August 15.
Comsat had postponed its annual meeting, originally scheduled for May 16, for the election of its directors, Wyser-Pratte said in a statement.

Providence Capital president Herbert Denton said the group was "delighted" to have the opportunity "to exercise (its) fundamental right to determine the future direction of the company by electing directors at the annual meeting.
"We are disappointed, however, that Comsat's board has not adopted a 'one share, one vote policy,'" he added.
